label: Flows and their value
subgoals: Respect capacities on arcs and conservation at inner vertices
Augment along s-t paths with spare residual capacity
Stop when no augmenting path remains

label: Cuts and their capacity
subgoals: Choose a source side containing s but not t
Sum the capacities of arcs from the source side to the sink side
Read each cut's capacity as an upper bound on the flow

label: Reading the minimum cut
subgoals: Collect the vertices reachable from s in the final residual graph
Check that arcs leaving that set are saturated
Widen only arcs that cross every minimum cut
